name: Material Science & Advanced Engineering
description: Offline materials intelligence with reviewed baselines and qualitative improvement analysis.
notes: No external API calls. Engineering profiles use reviewed records; trained weights and request context are not verified measurements.
Apply parameter filtering: omit irrelevant properties; never use N/A fillers.
No hallucination: if data is missing, use the exact offline fallback sentence.
Feedback is locally persistent and unverified; review it before updating knowledge or training weights.
Bare names trigger eight-section intelligence reports; no engineering-property prediction model is installed.
66 parameters remain a filtered coverage taxonomy; representative grades are explicitly labelled and no empty values are printed.
